comments.body: 2026-11-10: the clipboard half was lost, not late, and is fixed. It failed 1 run in 5 alone at low load, so load only made it likelier. The pane's program wrote OSC 52 as soon as the pane started, before the window attached; a clipboard write is shown live and never replayed, so a write made first went nowhere. COPIES now waits for a line the test types after attaching (both clipboard tests, since the deny test could pass without testing anything); 40 of 40 runs passed. Only windows::a_window_asked_for_onto_a_tab_takes_it is left on this card.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

description: Seen 2026-10-29 in two consecutive full gates at load 9.6 on the 10-core Mac (three agent builds beside the gate): windows::a_window_asked_for_onto_a_tab_takes_it ('timed out after 20s waiting for the third window to open onto the tab it asked for; window-3 shows Some(t2fe2bgpt2)') and then surface_input::a_programs_clipboard_write_reaches_the_window ('timed out after 20s waiting for the write to reach the window; the window heard []'). Each passed alone in 0.25-0.32 s, and the whole gate passed at load 2.7. Find what these two wait on that load can starve for 20 s, or whether something is lost rather than late.
title: 🎲 A seam window test times out at 20 s when the machine's fast cores are committed
